notes: Big multiplayer and setup update: public IPv6 remote play with one-tap address copy, savable reusable game configs, explosion thresholds from 3 to 6 with two double-blast styles, three victory conditions, an ML board-rating chart plus the most valuable move on the result and pause screens, and undo now jumps back to the previous human player
notes_zh: 联机与配置大改：新增公网 IPv6 远程联机（一键复制地址、自动判断能否跨网络）、游戏配置可存多套反复套用、爆炸阈值扩到 3~6 并可选双爆方式、新增三种胜负判定、结算与暂停页新增场面评分曲线与最具价值一步；悔棋自动跳到上一位真人
